citation.title: Carbon-FRCM materials for structural upgrade of masonry arch road bridges

document.accessNote: Repository records (UniFi Flore hdl.handle.net/2158/1009756, UniParthenope hdl.handle.net/11367/72573) carry the published PDF under restricted access.

abstract: In the present paper the design criteria for strengthening masonry bridges with carbon fiber reinforced cementitious matrix (C-FRCM) materials are presented with reference to a masonry arch road bridge built right after the second world war.
